description:
Replay a module's recent real entries on a changed automation, before saving it: each entry's own history (its create, then each activity on it) runs again inside a simulation with the change in place, and what it would do now is compared with what is stored. Nothing is saved or sent. Workspace admins only.

- `automation` is an automation as save_automation takes it (an existing one by id, with your change), replayed in its place.
- Without one, the replay checks that the saved design still reproduces what is stored.
- The last 5 entries changed by default (count up to 20), or the ones named by entryIds.
- The answer is { ok, checks, errors }: an entry the change would compute differently is a check with what is stored and what it would be now.

automation.description: The changed automation, as save_automation takes it

activity.description: An automation that runs when an activity is submitted: the activity's display name, or create / edit / delete / changeStatus / duplicate / assign

after.description: The graph run after the submit is saved; null removes it, omit to keep it

blocks.description: The graph's blocks by node id, as get_module_automations reads them: { "1": { "name": "start", ... }, "2": { "name": "sequence", "data": { "actions": [ ... ] }, ... } }

before.description: The graph run before the submit is saved; null removes it, omit to keep it

enabled.description: Switched on. A new automation is saved off unless this says true; switching on needs confirmed: true

execution.description: A schedule's run: { oncePerEntry, skipIfEmpty, catchUp, maxPerRun }

filter.description: A schedule's entries, the views' filter by display name. A date takes lt (before), lte (on or before), gt (after) or gte (on or after) with a date, or with { "duration": "day", "offset": 0 } for the run day: overdue is [ { "field": "Due Date", "operator": "lt", "payload": { "duration": "day", "offset": 0 } } ]; also on / within / in / past with { duration, offset }. A state is { "field": "state", "operator": "is", "payload": "Open" }. Group with { "type": "or", "items": [ ... ] } (or "and"). A condition the platform cannot read is refused.

id.description: The automation's id from get_module_automations; omit to add a new one

name.description: Unique in the module; required for a new one

run.description: A schedule's graph, run on each entry the filter matches

schedule.description: A schedule instead: when it runs, { "recurringType": "day" | "week" | "month" | "hour", "every": 1, "timeOfDay": "09:00" } (recurringWeeks and the month keys too)

tests.description: An activity automation's stored tests: sent, they replace its tests (a name keeps that stored test); [] removes them; omit to keep them. They run on every save and dry run, and switching on needs at least one, all passing. A schedule keeps none: its next run is simulated instead

anyOf.description: The name of a test stored for this automation: kept as it is

as.description: Who it acts as: { "member": username } or a position { "field": "Position", "value": "Manager" }. A position is checked, not run

field.description: Or a people-module field, e.g. Position

member.description: A member's username: the run acts as them

profile.description: The people module, when more than one has the field

value.description: ...and its value, e.g. Manager: the run checks what such a person may do

expect.description: What the run must do, e.g. { "check": "automation", "automation": "Post the voucher", "equals": "Completed" }, { "check": "state", "equals": "Posted" }, { "check": "field", "module": "Cash Book", "field": "Amount", "equals": 381.9 }, { "check": "preflight" } (every AutoCount code is in the book), { "check": "allowed", "equals": false }. None: the run must go through

check.description: ok, failed, created, changed, deleted, field, lines, state, branch, automation, notification, effect, preflight or allowed

steps.description: 1–20 activities run in order, inside a simulation: nothing is stored or sent

activity.description: The activity's name, or create / edit / delete / changeStatus

entryId.description: The entry it acts on: an id, or "$1" for the entry step 1 made

module.description: Another module's name; this module when left out

payload.description: The form, keyed by display name, as submit_activity takes it

count.description: How many recent entries, at most 20 (5 when left out)

entryIds.description: The entries to replay, instead of the most recent ones

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: replay_change
title: Replay Change
